description: Stacked histogram of Olympic athletes by weight (kg), stacked by sex, in 2kg-wide bins. Fork of the Observable notebook 'Details on demand, stacked histogram/bar chart' (https://observablehq.com/d/9c8c8fc749c73226#cell-1591), originally built with Observable Plot's Plot.rectY(olympians, Plot.binX({y:'count'}, {x:'weight', fill:'sex'})). Data: Observable Plot's own documentation dataset, athletes.csv (Rio 2016 Olympics).
